title: Packers HC Matt LaFleur speaks on 'special' chance to coach with brother Mike LaFleur in joint practice with Cardinals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers HC Matt LaFleur speaks on 'special' chance to coach with brother Mike LaFleur in joint practice with Cardinals
sources.description: Matt LaFleur joked that his younger brother and first-year head coach with Arizona was 'quick to criticize' some of his decisions, but said it's been 'good' working with him.
